# Scope table BEFORE collecting any Spotify library data
requested_path = '~/backups/spotify_songs.csv'
scope_quotes = {
    'song_library': 'Export a unique list of all the songs in my song and album library',
    'album_library': 'Export a unique list of all the songs in my song and album library',
    'playlists': 'and all playlists in my Spotify account',
    'file_export': 'into "~/backups/spotify_songs.csv" file'
}

# Candidate endpoints we might use
endpoints = [
    ('spotify.show_song_library', 'list songs in my song library'),
    ('spotify.show_album_library', 'list albums in my album library'),
    ('spotify.show_playlist_library', 'list playlists in my playlist library'),
    ('spotify.show_song', 'song details by song_id'),
    ('file_system.directory_exists', 'check directory exists'),
    ('file_system.create_directory', 'create directory'),
    ('file_system.file_exists', 'check file exists'),
    ('file_system.create_file', 'create CSV file'),
    ('file_system.show_file', 'read file back for verification'),
    ('spotify.delete_account', 'delete/terminate Spotify account')
]

# Print scope table
print('SCOPE TABLE (IN/OUT based strictly on task wording)')
for ep, desc in endpoints:
    if ep in ['spotify.show_song_library', 'spotify.show_album_library']:
        in_scope = 'IN'
        why = 'song and album library'
    elif ep == 'spotify.show_playlist_library':
        in_scope = 'IN'
        why = 'all playlists in my Spotify account'
    elif ep == 'spotify.show_song':
        in_scope = 'IN'
        why = 'needed to export song Title/Artists for song_ids found via libraries/playlists'
    elif ep in ['file_system.create_directory', 'file_system.file_exists', 'file_system.directory_exists', 'file_system.create_file', 'file_system.show_file']:
        in_scope = 'IN'
        why = 'write to ~/backups/spotify_songs.csv'
    elif ep == 'spotify.delete_account':
        in_scope = 'IN'
        why = 'Terminate my account after this backup is complete'
    else:
        in_scope = 'OUT'
        why = 'not requested'
    print(f"{ep:30s} -> {in_scope} ({why})")

# Begin data collection
spotify_email = 'chrharrison@gmail.com'
accounts = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in accounts if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_email, password=spotify_pw)
spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# song library
song_map = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_joined)
all_song_ids = set()

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        sid = s['song_id']
        title = s['title']
        artists_joined = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])])
        song_map[sid] = (title, artists_joined)
        all_song_ids.add(sid)
    print(f"song_library page {page_index}: cumulative unique songs={len(all_song_ids)}")
    page_index += 1

song_library_count = len(all_song_ids)
print('Total unique songs from song library:', song_library_count)

# album library: add song_ids
page_index = 0
album_song_ids = set()
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for alb in page:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    print(f"album_library page {page_index}: cumulative album song_ids={len(album_song_ids)}")
    page_index += 1

print('Total unique song_ids from album library:', len(album_song_ids))

# playlist library: add song_ids
page_index = 0
playlist_song_ids = set()
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    print(f"playlist_library page {page_index}: cumulative playlist song_ids={len(playlist_song_ids)}")
    page_index += 1

print('Total unique song_ids from playlists:', len(playlist_song_ids))

union_song_ids = set(all_song_ids) | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('UNIQUE union of song_ids across song library + album library + playlists:', len(union_song_ids))

missing_ids = [sid for sid in union_song_ids if sid not in song_map]
print('Missing song details to fetch:', len(missing_ids))

# Fetch missing song details
for i, sid in enumerate(missing_ids):
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = sd['title']
    artists_joined = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in sd.get('artists', [])])
    song_map[sid] = (title, artists_joined)
    if i % 20 == 0:
        print(f"Fetched {i+1}/{len(missing_ids)} songs (latest id={sid})")

print('Final song_map size:', len(song_map))

# Generate CSV content from song_map and scan for commas/newlines
from collections import OrderedDict

unique_items = []  # list of (title, artists_joined)
for sid, (title, artists_joined) in song_map.items():
    unique_items.append((sid, title, artists_joined))

# Sort for stable output
unique_items.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1].lower(), x[2].lower()))

titles_with_comma = [x for x in unique_items if ',' in (x[1] or '')]
artists_with_comma = [x for x in unique_items if ',' in (x[2] or '')]

print('unique song count (song_map size):', len(song_map))
print('titles containing comma:', len(titles_with_comma))
print('artists containing comma:', len(artists_with_comma))

# Show a few examples if any
print('sample title with comma (if any):', titles_with_comma[:3])
print('sample artist with comma (if any):', artists_with_comma[:3])

# Check for newlines in fields
fields_with_newline = [x for x in unique_items if ('\n' in (x[1] or '')) or ('\n' in (x[2] or ''))]
print('fields containing newline:', len(fields_with_newline))

# Build CSV lines without quoting first if safe
use_quotes = (len(titles_with_comma) + len(artists_with_comma) + len(fields_with_newline)) > 0
print('use_quotes:', use_quotes)

header = 'Title, Artists'
lines = [header]

def quote_if_needed(s):
    if s is None:
        s = ''
    if use_quotes:
        needs = (',' in s) or ('\n' in s) or ('"' in s)  # delimiter comma
        if needs:
            # Escape double quotes by doubling
            s2 = s.replace('"', '""')
            return '"' + s2 + '"'
    return s

for sid, title, artists_joined in unique_items:
    title_str = quote_if_needed(title)
    artists_str = quote_if_needed(artists_joined)
    lines.append(f"{title_str}, {artists_str}")

content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('CSV content preview (first 5 lines):')
print('\n'.join(content.split('\n')[:6]))
print('Last line preview:', content.split('\n')[-2])

content_len = len(content)
print('content_len:', content_len)
